package.name: roarm_m2_adapter
package.description: Inert-by-default M2 multi-joint mock-press orchestrator for RoArm-M3. No target publisher and no arm client until single explicit authorization; entering the press and retract phases each requires a separate one-shot operator confirmation; on any fault it disarms, destroys the publisher, and never retries. After the return phase it awaits an M0-B post-verify result.
